text: Functions tramoseats_refresh tramo_refresh allow create new specification updating existing one. selected parameters kept fixed others freed within boundaries reference specification. practice freed parameter specification updated (spec) replaced corresponding parameter reference specification (refspec). See details examples.

title: Refresh a specification with constraints — refresh
code: tramo_refresh(   spec,   refspec = NULL,   policy = c("FreeParameters", "Complete", "Outliers_StochasticComponent", "Outliers",     "FixedParameters", "FixedAutoRegressiveParameters", "Fixed", "Current"),   period = 0,   start = NULL,   end = NULL )  tramoseats_refresh(   spec,   refspec = NULL,   policy = c("FreeParameters", "Complete", "Outliers_StochasticComponent", "Outliers",     "FixedParameters", "FixedAutoRegressiveParameters", "Fixed", "Current"),   period = 0,   start = NULL,   end = NULL )

title: Refresh a specification with constraints — refresh
text: spec specification refreshed Object class "JD3_tramoseats_SPEC" "JD3_tramo_SPEC", can obtained output tramoseats_spec tramo_spec customised set_ functions, see tramoseats_spec documentation refspec reference specification default "rsa4" "tr5" specification. Object class "JD3_tramoseats_SPEC" "JD3_tramo_SPEC", can obtained output tramoseats_spec tramo_spec customised set_ functions, see tramoseats_spec documentation policy refresh policy apply (see details) period, start, end additional parameters used specify span policy = "Current" policy = "Outliers" policy = "Outliers_StochasticComponent" period: numeric, number observations year (12, 4...), compulsory, false missing, re-estimation refreshed specification work. policy = "Outliers" policy = "Outliers_StochasticComponent" start specified date outliers re-identified end used, specified ignored. policy = "Current" start end specified indicate span additive outliers (AO) added. Span definition: start end: defined arrays two elements: year first period (example, period = 12 start=c(1980, 1) stands January 1980)

title: Refresh a specification with constraints — refresh
text: new specification, object class "JD3_tramoseats_SPEC" "JD3_tramo_SPEC".

title: Refresh a specification with constraints — refresh
text: particular selection parameters kept fixed re-estimated called revision policy. Available refresh policies : Current: applying current pre-adjustment reg-arima model handling new raw data points, sub-span series Additive Outliers (defined new intervention variables); SEATS Benchmarking part parameters untouched. Fixed: applying current pre-adjustment reg-arima model replacing forecasts new raw data points; SEATS Benchmarking part parameters untouched. FixedParameters: pre-adjustment reg-arima model partially modified: regression coefficients re-estimated regression variables, Arima orders coefficients unchanged; FixedAutoRegressiveParameters: FixedParameters Arima Moving Average coefficients (MA) also re-estimated, Auto-regressive (AR) coefficients kept fixed; SEATS Benchmarking part parameters untouched. FreeParameters: regression Arima model coefficients re-estimated, regression variables Arima orders kept fixed; SEATS Benchmarking part parameters untouched. Outliers: regression variables Arima orders kept fixed, outliers re-detected defined span, thus regression Arima model coefficients re-estimated; SEATS Benchmarking part parameters untouched. Outliers_StochasticComponent: "Outliers" Arima model orders (p,d,q)(P,D,Q) can also re-identified; SEATS Benchmarking part parameters untouched. Complete: parameters re-identified re-estimated, unless constrained domain spec. SEATS Benchmarking part parameters entirely reset values reference spec.

title: Refresh a specification with constraints — refresh
text: information revision policies JDemetra+ documentation: https://doc.jdemetra.org/-rev-policies

title: Refresh a specification with constraints — refresh
code: if (FALSE) { # rjd3toolkit::get_java_version() >= rjd3toolkit::minimal_java_version library("rjd3toolkit") y <- rjd3toolkit::ABS$X0.2.08.10.M # raw series for first estimation y_raw <- window(y, end = c(2016, 12)) # raw series for second (refreshed) estimation: new data points y_new <- window(y, end = c(2017, 6)) # \donttest{ # Example 1 : refresh mechanism # Create reference spec, here the default "rsa3" rsa3<- tramoseats_spec("rsa3") # Customize this spec ## Tramo part ### For example, disable automatic arima modelling user_spec <- set_automodel(rsa3, enabled = FALSE) ### set a user-defined arima model user_spec <- set_arima(    user_spec,    mean = 0.2,    mean.type = "Fixed",    p = 1,    d = 2,    q = 0,    bp = 1,    bd = 1,    bq = 0,    coef = c(0.6, 0.7),    coef.type = c("Initial", "Fixed") ) #print(user_spec)  ## Customize the x11 part user_spec<-set_seats(user_spec,                     fcasts = -2,                     bcasts = -1,                     trend.boundary=0.6,                     seas.boundary=0.75,                     algorithm= "KalmanSmoother") #print(user_spec) user_spec<- set_benchmarking(    user_spec,    enabled = TRUE,    target = "Original",    rho = 0.7,    lambda = 0.5,    forecast = TRUE,    bias = "Multiplicative") #print(user_spec) # Use policy: "Outliers_StochasticComponent" tramoseats_spec_ref <- tramoseats_refresh(spec= user_spec,                            refspec= rsa3,                            policy = "Outliers_StochasticComponent" ) # print(tramoseats_spec_ref) # user defined reg-arima model is reset and outliers will be re-identified # on the whole series as no start and end specified, SEATS and Benchmarking parameters # are left unchanged # Use policy: "Complete" tramoseats_spec_ref <- tramoseats_refresh(spec= user_spec,                            refspec= rsa3,                            policy = "Complete" ) # print(tramoseats_spec_ref) # all user defined parameters are reset and replaced with "rsa3" parameters, # Example 2 : practical re-estimation use-case sa_tramoseats <- tramoseats(y_raw, user_spec) # refreshing the specification resulting from the first estimation # to partially adapt to new data spec_to_refresh <- sa_tramoseats$result_spec reference_spec <- sa_tramoseats$estimation_spec # policy = "Fixed" spec_tramoseats_ref <- tramoseats_refresh(spec_to_refresh,                             reference_spec,                             policy = "Fixed" ) # 2nd estimation with refreshed specification sa_tramoseats_ref <- tramoseats(y_new, spec_tramoseats_ref) # policy = "Outliers" spec_tramoseats_ref <- tramoseats_refresh(spec_to_refresh,                            reference_spec,                            policy = "Outliers",                            period = 12,                            start = c(2017, 1) ) # outliers will be re-detected from January 2017 included # 2nd estimation with refreshed specification sa_tramoseats_ref <- tramoseats(y_new, spec_tramoseats_ref)  # policy = "Current"  spec_tramoseats_ref <- tramoseats_refresh(spec_to_refresh,                            reference_spec,                            policy = "Current",                            period = 12,                            start = c(2017, 1),                            end = end(y_new) ) sa_tramoseats_ref <- tramoseats(y_new, spec_tramoseats_ref) # } # Points from January 2017 (included) until the end of the series will be # treated as Additive Outliers, the previous reg-Arima model being otherwise # kept fixed 2nd estimation with refreshed specification }

title: SEATS Decomposition — seats_decompose
text: sarima SARIMA model (see rjd3toolkit::sarima_model()). seas.tolerance numeric: seasonal tolerance (epsphi). tolerance (measured degrees) allocate AR non-real roots seasonal component (modulus inverse complex AR root greater trend boundary frequency root differs one seasonal frequencies less Seasonal tolerance) transitory component (otherwise). Possible values [0,10]. Default value 2. trend.boundary numeric: trend boundary (rmod). boundary beyond AR root integrated trend component. modulus inverse real root greater trend boundary, AR root integrated trend component. value, root integrated transitory component. Possible values [0,1]. Default = 0.5. seas.boundary numeric: seasonal boundary (sbound). boundary beyond real negative AR root integrated seasonal component. modulus inverse negative real root greater (equal) Seasonal boundary, AR root integrated seasonal component. Otherwise root integrated trend transitory component. Possible values [0,1]. Default=0.8. seas.boundary.unique numeric: seasonal boundary (unique), (sboundatpi). boundary beyond negative AR root integrated seasonal component, root unique seasonal root.  modulus inverse negative real root greater (equal) Seasonal boundary, AR root integrated seasonal component. Otherwise root integrated trend transitory component. Possible values [0,1]. Default=0.8. approximation character: approximation mode. ARIMA model estimated TRAMO accept admissible decomposition, SEATS: "None" - performs approximation; "Legacy" - replaces model decomposable one; "Noisy" - estimates new model adding white noise non-admissible model estimated TRAMO. Default="Legacy".

title: Set Seats Specification — set_seats
text: x specification modified, object class "JD3_TRAMOSEATS_SPEC", generated tramoseats_spec() function approximation character: approximation mode. ARIMA model estimated TRAMO accept admissible decomposition, SEATS: "None" - performs approximation; "Legacy" - replaces model decomposable one; "Noisy" - estimates new model adding white noise non-admissible model estimated TRAMO. Default="Legacy". trend.boundary numeric: trend boundary (rmod). boundary beyond AR root integrated trend component. modulus inverse real root greater trend boundary, AR root integrated trend component. value, root integrated transitory component. Possible values [0,1]. Default = 0.5. seas.boundary numeric: seasonal boundary (sbound). boundary beyond real negative AR root integrated seasonal component. modulus inverse negative real root greater (equal) Seasonal boundary, AR root integrated seasonal component. Otherwise root integrated trend transitory component. Possible values [0,1]. Default=0.8. seas.boundary.unique numeric: seasonal boundary (unique), (sboundatpi). boundary beyond negative AR root integrated seasonal component, root unique seasonal root.  modulus inverse negative real root greater (equal) Seasonal boundary, AR root integrated seasonal component. Otherwise root integrated trend transitory component. Possible values [0,1]. Default=0.8. seas.tolerance numeric: seasonal tolerance (epsphi). tolerance (measured degrees) allocate AR non-real roots seasonal component (modulus inverse complex AR root greater trend boundary frequency root differs one seasonal frequencies less Seasonal tolerance) transitory component (otherwise). Possible values [0,10]. Default value 2. ma.boundary numeric: MA unit root boundary. modulus estimated MA root falls range [xl, 1], set xl. Possible values [0.9,1]. Default=0.95. bcasts, fcasts numeric: number backasts (bcasts) forecasts (fcasts) used decomposition periods (positive values) years (negative values). Default bcasts = 0. Default fcasts = 0. algorithm character: estimation method unobserved components. choice can made : Burman: default value. May result significant underestimation components' standard deviation, may become numerically unstable roots MA polynomial near 1; KalmanSmoother: disturbed (quasi-) unit roots MA. bias boolean. TRUE (default) decomposition multiplicative correction applied computing final components (S, T, ) level components estimated log. Average S (complete years) (whole series) set 1, correction allocated T.
